role_description: Classifies the intent of an incoming customer query into one of five categories and routes it to the correct downstream handler. First decision gate in the pipeline — misclassification here corrupts all downstream stages.

output_schema.intent: string — one of: billing, technical, policy, refund, escalation
output_schema.routing_rationale: string — one-sentence explanation of the classification
output_schema.routing_ambiguous: boolean — true if query could belong to multiple intents

system_prompt_summary: Intent classifier. Maps free-text query to one of 5 fixed labels. Returns structured JSON.
constraints: Must return exactly one intent label — no multi-label output
Must return valid JSON — fallback to escalation on parse failure
Temperature must be 0 for deterministic routing
eval_focus: Graceful handling of ambiguous or multi-intent queries
Edge case handling: empty input, non-English, very short queries
